content: Time and the ocean tide wait for no mortal king.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
sourceWork: King Canute Legend & Old English / Norse Maritime Wisdom
explanation: King Canute set his throne on the seashore and commanded the rising tide to stop, demonstrating to his flattering courtiers that imperial crowns are powerless before cosmic reality. Stop putting off what is vital: the tide is rising, and time will not pause for your convenience.
practicalInsight: Act with urgency on your most important life priorities today. Do not assume tomorrow is guaranteed.
reflectionPrompt: What critical conversation or creative work are you postponing, pretending that time will wait for you?
